day.headline: A Horse day — Tiger and Dog are in step.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Horse — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Mute it this morning. No unfollow, no announcement, just quiet.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Horse — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Sky's fine. Leave the umbrella by the door and go.

reasons: Rat opposes Horse — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: a series you are only half watching
signs.message: Abandon it mid-season, no guilt. Tonight's for something you'd choose.

reasons: Tiger and Horse share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the first ten minutes of the day
signs.message: Don't reach for your phone first. Stand up, start moving.

reasons: Goat pairs with Horse — a harmonious day
signs.message: Eleven days left in this month. Pick one thing, finish it.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Horse — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: an impulse buy on the way
signs.message: Grab the little thing you spot en route. Zero deliberation.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Horse — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the shop with the good window
signs.message: Stop at that window two minutes, then keep walking.

reasons: Snake sits apart from Horse — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: something bought because it was reduced
signs.message: Wear the sale one tonight. That's what buying it was for.

reasons: Horse's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Don't fight the zipper. Something forgiving, and a slow morning.

reasons: Dog and Horse share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the last of the good weather
signs.message: Warm nights are winding down. Enjoy this one from indoors.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Horse — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: It can stay on read tonight. Nobody's timing you.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Horse — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: One try was plenty. The second one keeps till tomorrow.
